name: Teacher portfolio iris and curiosity lens

style_rules.display: Locally packaged Instrument Serif 400 upright and italic, at minus .025em tracking. Source Sans 3 for UI/body; existing Source Serif 4 retained for reading prose. No synthesized Instrument weights.
style_rules.hero: Indigo #243BA5; warm-white text #FAF7EE, secondary #D9DEF2 and quiet citron #DBE6AE. Display title6.5rem to12rem, phone4rem to7.8rem with responsive320px adjustment.
style_rules.student: Pale sage #E6E8D4 with #242B45 text and #4F5A63 secondary text. Dark slate-blue and olive contour lines replace bright green/cyan strokes.
style_rules.reading: Warm paper #F4F1E8 with off-white #FCFAF4 surfaces and neutral #E9E7DD accents; main ink #22283F and secondary #596172.
style_rules.manifesto: Dark navy #1E263F, warm-white headings #FAF7EE, secondary #D7DBEE and italic accent #DBE6AE.
style_rules.opening: Masked two-line name followed by a circular native even-odd clip-path aperture. Sixty-four circle points interpolate from half a pixel to half the stage diagonal plus two pixels over1150ms after1050ms. Thin matching ring. Total opening bounded by2600ms; fade fallback, resize dismissal and existing Skip/Escape/focus/scroll exits.
style_rules.details: Hero role, availability, study and control text enlarged; desktop labels .875rem to.9rem, phone .8rem to.82rem. Decorative footer sentence hidden on phones; interactive controls retained.
style_rules.graphics: Existing original atlas geometry at72percent CSS opacity, pointer response and motion preferences unchanged.
style_rules.font_source: Instrument Serif library entry google-instrumentserif; verified unmodified TTFs, pinned Google Fonts commit67bc647ce1910e92f461bcc82aae30f21d21a9cc, full OFL notice retained. Fonts are project-packaged; no global path or runtime external request.
style_rules.curiosity_lens: Decorative240px to340px circular approved-gallery photo window with18px inset, thin orbit and crosshair. Pointer position eases with240ms exponential inertia; opacity uses110ms entry and70ms exit easing, normalized to elapsed time inside the existing24fps atlas render loop. First eligible desktop demonstration lasts2300ms. Normal cursor remains; effect fades at interactive controls.
style_rules.lens_contrast: Teacher photo uses #142047 at72percent scrim opacity; Student photo uses #E6E8D4 at74percent scrim opacity, protecting hero text over either photograph extreme. Captions inherit scene text and muted tokens.
style_rules.touch: 180px lens on phones. A short background tap produces a1050ms ring/photo response that fades out. Pointer movement beyond9px or longer than450ms does not trigger a tap; no default scrolling behavior is prevented.
style_rules.lifecycle: Uses the existing atlas requestAnimationFrame loop,24fps/DPR1.5caps and visibility checks. Reduced motion, data saving, visitor pause and document hiding settle effects. No extra continuous loop, observer, animation library, media file or remote dependency.
